# Written by hand, next to the generated src/main/baseline-prof.txt; AGP merges every file in
# this directory with it.
#
# BaselineProfileGenerator runs the benchmark app on the fake relay (src/benchmark), so the
# generated profile never reaches the real transport that connects every release cold start:
# release's remoteTransport() factory, SecureRemoteTransport, SecureChannel's encryption, the wire
# helpers and OkHttp's WebSocket. Keep these rules when the generated file is replaced; see
# docs/runbooks/macrobenchmarks.md.

HSPLde/joinnoah/pi/remote/SecureChannel$**;->**(**)**

HSPLde/joinnoah/pi/remote/Wire$**;->**(**)**
